rationale: With only 5 minutes remaining before the mandatory close liquidation, XPRO is chopping tightly between $13.31 and $13.40 on rapidly declining 1-minute volume (down to 9.2k shares) just below its 5-minute 9-EMA ($13.42) and VWAP ($13.48).
